title: Message Bridge
description: Read short notices and messages. Identify instructions, changes, permissions and purpose.

questions.prompt:
READING CLUB: Tuesday's meeting will be in Room 8, not Room 3. The starting time is unchanged.

What has changed?
questions.explanation: The room changes from 3 to 8; the time stays the same.

questions.prompt:
PHOTO DISPLAY: Send a copy of your family picture. Keep the original safely at home.

What should pupils send?
options: A copy of a family picture.
questions.explanation: The notice asks for a copy and says to keep the original at home.

questions.prompt:
LIBRARY: Return borrowed storybooks by Monday. Reference books must stay in the library.

Which books may pupils borrow?
questions.explanation: Storybooks can be borrowed; reference books must remain in the library.

questions.prompt:
Dear Sami, I have bought the card. Could you bring some wrapping paper? We already have a gift. — Lina

What does Lina want Sami to bring?
questions.explanation: Lina already has the card and gift; she asks for wrapping paper.

questions.prompt:
MUSEUM TRIP: Bring a packed lunch and water. There is no cafe at the museum.

Why must pupils bring lunch?
options: They must give food to the guide.
There is no cafe at the museum.
Food is not allowed on the trip.
questions.explanation: The notice explains that the museum has no cafe.

questions.prompt:
DRAMA CLUB: Rehearsal begins at 2:15. Please arrive ten minutes early to get ready.

When should pupils arrive?
questions.explanation: Ten minutes before 2:15 is 2:05.

questions.prompt:
ART ROOM: Wash your brushes after use and put them in the blue container.

What should pupils do first?
questions.explanation: The instructions say to wash brushes before putting them away.

questions.prompt:
SCHOOL FAIR: Entry is free. Tickets are needed only for the games.

What must visitors pay for?
questions.explanation: Only the games require tickets; entry is free.

questions.prompt:
To Noor: Please borrow the atlas from the library before our project meeting. I will bring the photos. — Adam

Who will bring the photos?
questions.explanation: Adam writes that he will bring the photos; Noor should borrow the atlas.

questions.prompt:
SWIMMING LESSON: Today's lesson is cancelled because the pool is closed. Lessons return next Friday.

What does the notice say?
options: There is no swimming lesson today.
Today's lesson is at a different pool.
questions.explanation: Only today's lesson is cancelled; lessons return next Friday.

questions.prompt:
FAMILY HISTORY DISPLAY: Label the back of each copy with a date if you know it. Leave unknown dates blank.

What should pupils do if a date is unknown?
questions.explanation: The notice says to leave unknown dates blank rather than guess.

questions.prompt:
BOOK SWAP: Bring one book in good condition and choose one to take home.

How does the book swap work?
options: Give one suitable book and receive another.
Bring a book but take nothing home.
Take as many books as you want.
questions.explanation: Visitors exchange one book for another.

questions.prompt:
GARDEN CLUB: Wear old shoes on Saturday. We will be planting outside even if the ground is wet.

Why are old shoes recommended?
options: New shoes are part of the uniform.
questions.explanation: Planting in wet ground may make shoes muddy.

questions.prompt:
NOTICE: The north entrance is closed for repairs. Please use the entrance beside the sports hall.

What should visitors do?
questions.explanation: The notice directs visitors to the entrance beside the sports hall.

questions.prompt:
Dear parents, the exhibition opens at 4:00. Pupils helping with displays should be here at 3:30.

Who needs to arrive at 3:30?
questions.explanation: The earlier arrival time applies to pupils helping with displays.

questions.prompt:
HISTORY TALK: Places are limited. Register with your teacher before Thursday to reserve a seat.

Why should pupils register?
options: To reserve a place at the talk.
questions.explanation: Registering reserves one of the limited places.

questions.prompt:
MUSIC ROOM: You may practise here at lunchtime, but ask permission before moving any instruments.

What requires permission?
questions.explanation: The notice allows practice but requires permission to move instruments.

questions.prompt:
LOST PROPERTY: A green lunchbox was found near the playground. Describe its contents to the office staff to collect it.

How can the owner collect the lunchbox?
options: Ask a friend to guess its colour.
questions.explanation: The owner must describe the contents to office staff.

questions.prompt:
PROJECT REMINDER: Work with a partner, but each pupil must submit a separate reflection.

What must pupils submit individually?
questions.explanation: The project is in pairs, but the reflection is individual.

questions.prompt:
SCHOOL SHOP: Notebooks are sold out. More will arrive on Wednesday; pencils are still available.

What can pupils buy now?
questions.explanation: Notebooks are sold out, while pencils remain available.

questions.prompt:
Dear Rami, please do not wait for me at the gate. I will meet you inside the library. — Omar

Where should Rami meet Omar?
questions.explanation: Omar changes the meeting point to inside the library.

questions.prompt:
SCIENCE DISPLAY: Visitors may look closely at the models, but must not touch them.

What is allowed?
questions.explanation: Looking is allowed; touching is forbidden.

questions.prompt:
FILM CLUB: The film is suitable for all ages. Younger children must come with an adult.

What must younger children do?
questions.explanation: Younger children can attend if an adult accompanies them.

questions.prompt:
COACH TRIP: The coach leaves at 8:00 sharp. Be at school by 7:45.

What time must pupils be at school?
questions.explanation: Pupils must arrive by 7:45, before the coach leaves.

questions.prompt:
READING CHALLENGE: Record the title of every book you finish. Books you start but do not finish do not count.

Which books count?
questions.explanation: Only completed books count towards the challenge.

questions.prompt:
COSTUME DAY: You may wear a costume, but comfortable school shoes are still required.

What must pupils wear?
questions.explanation: Costumes are optional; suitable school shoes are required.

questions.prompt:
CHARITY SALE: All money raised will buy books for a village school.

What is the purpose of the sale?
options: To fund books for a school.
To pay for a class party.
questions.explanation: The notice states that all proceeds will buy books for the village school.

questions.prompt:
SPORTS PRACTICE: Bring your water bottle. Balls and other equipment will be provided.

What do pupils need to bring?
questions.explanation: The equipment is provided; pupils only need their water bottles.

questions.prompt:
CLASS MESSAGE: The deadline for the poster is now Sunday, two days later than planned.

What does the message mean?
options: Pupils have extra time for the poster.
Pupils must finish two days earlier.
questions.explanation: A later deadline gives pupils two additional days.

questions.prompt:
EXHIBITION: Please leave large bags at reception. Small bags may be carried inside.

Which bags may visitors take inside?
questions.explanation: Large bags must stay at reception; small bags are allowed inside.
